visible_text: Sharing Session by the Champion Team
Team Innogrow, winner of the HKAE Pitching Competition 2024–25, will share their journey about how they started from initial inspiration to developing a successful innovation.
This session will offer exclusive insights into how a real student-led idea transformed into a viable, award-winning project:
“Smart Weeding Solutions for a Sustainable Future”
Venue: Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing One
HKA E Pitch Competition on Grand Challenge Engineering Topics for University Students 2024-25
The activity is supported by Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund and Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund.
spatial_relations: A large headline 'PITCH NEW TECH IDEAS' is centered across the very top of the poster.
Below the headline, a left-aligned inset photograph occupies the left third to half of the poster; the photograph shows six people standing in front of a large screen.

To the right of the inset photograph is the main descriptive text block starting with 'Team Innogrow, winner of the HKAE Pitching Competition 2024–25...' continuing downward; this text is right of the inset photograph and roughly centered vertically in the poster.
The date, time and venue lines are placed near the lower-left quadrant of the poster, beneath the inset photograph area.
Two QR codes are arranged side-by-side in the lower-right quadrant of the poster; above each QR code are small headings reading 'REGISTER NOW' (left) and 'PITCH NEW TECH IDEA 2026' (right).
A small rectangular logo panel reading 'Innovation Academy Faculty of Engineering, HKU' is located in the top-right corner of the poster.
